statusLine.command: input=$(cat); dir=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir' | sed "s|^$HOME|~|"); usage=$(echo "$input" | jq '.context_window.current_usage'); if [ "$usage" != "null" ]; then current=$(echo "$usage" | jq '.input_tokens + .cache_creation_input_tokens + .cache_read_input_tokens'); size=$(echo "$input" | jq '.context_window.context_window_size'); pct=$((current * 100 / size)); printf '%s | %d%% context' "$dir" "$pct"; else printf '%s' "$dir"; fi

hooks.command: curl -X POST -H 'Content-type: application/json' --data '{"text":"Claude Code needs your attention"}' https://REDACTED
curl -X POST -H 'Content-type: application/json' --data '{"text":"Claude Code finished"}' https://REDACTED
